text_markup: The Runner is playing as {card:Exile} and plays Test Run, searching their heap for a program. Although the program is set aside before being installed, {card:Exile}'s ability treats it as though it were installed directly from the heap, and so {card:Exile} will draw a card.
text_plain: The Runner is playing as Exile and plays Test Run, searching their heap for a program. Although the program is set aside before being installed, Exile's ability treats it as though it were installed directly from the heap, and so Exile will draw a card.
